@'
import re, os

path = r"X:\code\copilot-worktrees\P06\cirvine-msft-didactic-robot\assets\due.txt"

D = ["##### ", "#    #", "#    #", "#    #", "#    #", "##### "]
U = ["#    #", "#    #", "#    #", "#    #", "#    #", " #### "]
E = ["######", "#     ", "##### ", "#     ", "#     ", "######"]

top = "+" + "=" * 28 + "+"
blank = "|" + " " * 28 + "|"

def wrap(content):
    pad = 28 - len(content)
    left = pad // 2
    right = pad - left
    return "|" + " " * left + content + " " * right + "|"

letter_rows = []
for i in range(6):
    content = D[i] + "  " + U[i] + "  " + E[i]
    letter_rows.append(wrap(content))

subtitle = wrap("DUE  REMINDER")

lines = [top, blank] + letter_rows + [blank, subtitle, blank, top]

text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
with open(path, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write(text)

# ---- verify ----
raw = open(path, "rb").read()
assert raw[-1:] == b"\n" and raw[-2:] != b"\n\n", "trailing newline check failed"
content_lines = raw.decode("ascii").split("\n")
assert content_lines[-1] == "", "must end with exactly one newline"
body = content_lines[:-1]
allowed = set(" ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789+|/\\_*.#():=-")
lengths = [len(l) for l in body]
for idx, l in enumerate(body, 1):
    assert set(l) <= allowed, f"line {idx} bad chars"
    assert not l.endswith(" "), f"line {idx} trailing space"
    assert 20 <= len(l) <= 48, f"line {idx} length {len(l)} out of range"
assert len(body) == 12, f"expected 12 lines got {len(body)}"
assert "DUE" in raw.decode("ascii"), "literal DUE missing"

print("OK")
print("line_count:", len(body))
print("min_len:", min(lengths), "max_len:", max(lengths))
print("---- file ----")
print(raw.decode("ascii"), end="")
'@ | python -
